title: What's New in 1.1.6
summary: Expert Sheets now lets you choose and manage your DWG export setups, and the new ReNumber tool gets reusable rules.
content:
Expert Sheets: DWG export setups. Pick any DWG/DXF export setup stored in your project straight from Expert Sheets, and keep editing them in Revit's own dialog. If a project has none, an "A2Z Default" setup is created for you.

ReNumber: reusable rules. Build rules with multiple categories, a target parameter per category, optional family-type filters, and Constant / Increment / Field parts with numeric or A, B, C increments. Rules can be duplicated, edited, imported and exported, and your edits are never overwritten by updates.

sections.title: Expert Sheets: DWG export setups
sections.text: Choose any DWG/DXF export setup stored in your project right from Expert Sheets, and keep editing them in Revit's own "Modify DWG/DXF Export Setup" dialog. If your project doesn't have one yet, an "A2Z Default" setup is created for you.

sections.title: ReNumber: reusable rules
sections.text: Build rules once and reuse them: several categories per rule, a target parameter for each, optional family-type filters, and Constant / Increment / Field parts with numeric or A, B, C increments. Duplicate, edit, import and export rules from the rules manager. Edited built-in rules are kept in your own folder and are never overwritten by an update.
